props.gloss_en: one who was standing in prayer and remembered that he had already prayed stops -- even in the middle of a blessing
those of the school of Rav who erred and mentioned the weekday [blessing] on Shabbat -- may they complete it? Rabba bar Avuh: they complete that entire blessing
there the man is one who is obligated [in the prayer]; but here he has already prayed
and it is the Rabbis who did not trouble him, because of the honour of Shabbat
